answer: Give every identity a home cluster — a haven where its reputation lives — and make reputation non-portable: moving to another cluster resets trust to zero, so a sybil cannot clone one good record into many. Inside a haven, identities join a trellis of mutual attestation: each member must verify the work of unrelated peers, and trust only grows when checks pass. Climbing the ridge to full privileges takes weeks of verified work plus a deposit slashed if attestation is ever exposed as fake, so an attacker pays in time, deposits, and honest work for every fake identity.
